name: OpenCut
implementationLessons: Study the product boundary and media-first workflow; reuse is only after reviewing each file licence and dependency.

name: Kdenlive
implementationLessons: Separate timeline model from MLT render graph; proxy suggestions belong to media metadata, not UI guesses.

name: Kdenlive developer docs
implementationLessons: Inspect established NLE failure handling and render/effect boundaries before adding a native backend.

name: MLT
implementationLessons: A graph/playlist model scales better than clip-specific UI conditionals; keep an adapter so OmniFrame can use FFmpeg/native later.

name: OpenTimelineIO
implementationLessons: Use stable IDs and explicit time transforms; import/export is an interchange boundary, not the native project format.

name: OTIO schema docs
implementationLessons: Time ranges and rational rates prevent frame drift; OmniFrame stores integer sequence frames and can export OTIO later.

name: LosslessCut
implementationLessons: Fast path and explicit keyframe limitations are worth surfacing; do not pretend frame-accurate re-encode is lossless.

name: OpenShot
implementationLessons: Simple entry flows are useful for launcher UX, while its larger dependency surface is a caution for the native shell.

name: Olive
implementationLessons: Keep preview/export on one graph and make property animation data-driven.

name: Shotcut
implementationLessons: Filter parameter UX and export preset disclosure are useful; do not copy implementation.

name: OBS Studio
implementationLessons: A source/scene abstraction informs OmniFrame’s 2D/3D composition model and capability probing.

name: libobs API
implementationLessons: Explicit resource ownership and signal-driven lifecycle are valuable patterns for workers/jobs.

name: Remotion
implementationLessons: A frame is a first-class render input; use this principle for preview/export parity without turning OmniFrame into a template-only system.

name: FFmpeg
implementationLessons: Native desktop should wrap capability discovery and structured errors; browser path needs WebCodecs/WASM alternatives.
codeReuse: External executable/library subject to build audit

name: FFmpeg filters documentation
implementationLessons: Filter names and pixel-format conversions are a compatibility reference; graph semantics should be tested against export output.

name: FFmpeg pixel formats
implementationLessons: Make transfer function, alpha mode and range explicit at every native boundary.

name: libplacebo
implementationLessons: Color management and presentation transforms should remain separate from creative effects.

name: VapourSynth
implementationLessons: Lazy frame evaluation informs cache/job prioritisation, but the plugin ecosystem needs a separate sandbox.

name: Krita
implementationLessons: Selection modifier semantics and per-frame manual correction are behavioural references; do not copy source.

name: Krita selection tools docs
implementationLessons: Expose selection operations and modifiers directly, not behind an advanced drawer.

name: Krita animation docs
implementationLessons: Frame navigation and correction must be practical at timeline level.

name: DaVinci Resolve training
implementationLessons: Use as behaviour reference for dense workspaces and mode separation; proprietary implementation is not reused.

name: Adobe Premiere keyboard shortcuts
implementationLessons: Common shortcuts reduce learning cost; OmniFrame makes them configurable.

name: Final Cut Pro user guide
implementationLessons: Roles and compound timelines inform track metadata; do not mimic magnetic editing as the only mode.

name: WebCodecs API MDN
implementationLessons: Use direct VideoFrame transfer and close resources deterministically; WebCodecs does not mux containers.

name: WebCodecs specification
implementationLessons: Capability probing must be async and configuration-specific.

name: WebCodecs samples
implementationLessons: Use the sample lifecycle patterns for queue backpressure and frame closing.

name: MP4Box.js
implementationLessons: WebCodecs chunks need a container layer; keep muxing separate from the renderer.

name: mp4-muxer
implementationLessons: Small muxer APIs are suitable for browser export, but verify maintenance and licence at release.

name: FFmpeg.wasm
implementationLessons: Use only as a fallback; large WASM and memory pressure make it unsuitable for interactive frames.
license: MIT wrapper; FFmpeg licence applies to core

name: Web Workers MDN
implementationLessons: Long operations need cancellation and transferable data, not main-thread loops.

name: OffscreenCanvas MDN
implementationLessons: Preview composition can leave the main thread; feature-detect and use a Canvas2D fallback.

name: Transferable objects MDN
implementationLessons: Avoid copy-heavy VideoFrame → PNG → ImageData pipelines.

name: WebGPU API MDN
implementationLessons: WebGPU is an acceleration path, not a product requirement; the renderer reports CPU/WASM fallback.

name: WebGPU spec
implementationLessons: Explicit resource destruction and device-lost handling are required.

name: WebGL spec
implementationLessons: WebGL remains the 3D fallback where WebGPU is unavailable.

name: WebAssembly
implementationLessons: A Rust/WASM CV path can share algorithms with desktop, but transfer overhead must be measured.

name: Web Audio API MDN
implementationLessons: Keep preview monitoring separate from offline export mixdown.

name: AudioWorklet MDN
implementationLessons: Do not run waveform analysis in the UI thread; AudioWorklet is for realtime monitoring, not batch export.

name: Web Audio samples
implementationLessons: Automation/keyframe timing needs the same rational timebase as video.

name: File System Access API
implementationLessons: Use permissioned handles where available and IndexedDB for persistence metadata.

name: IndexedDB MDN
implementationLessons: Never put media binaries in localStorage; use IndexedDB/OPFS and an explicit cache budget.

name: Origin Private File System
implementationLessons: OPFS is a strong web cache target for thumbnails/proxies while project JSON stays portable.

name: OpenCV
implementationLessons: Use established primitives in native/WASM adapters; keep the built-in TypeScript reference path testable.

name: OpenCV optical flow docs
implementationLessons: Sparse LK plus pyramids is a strong fast baseline; dense flow should be opt-in.

name: OpenCV goodFeaturesToTrack
implementationLessons: Track gradients and texture, not raw pixel identity.

name: Lucas-Kanade paper
implementationLessons: The local structure tensor explains why flat/one-dimensional edges are weak features.

name: Shi-Tomasi paper
implementationLessons: Use minimum eigenvalue and non-maximum suppression for stable sparse points.

name: RANSAC paper
implementationLessons: Camera motion is the dominant model; subject motion should be treated as residual/outliers.

name: TAPIR
implementationLessons: Research informs confidence/occlusion concepts; a model must pass licence/packaging review before shipping.

name: TAPIR paper
implementationLessons: Persistent identity needs memory and visibility state, not fixed coordinates.

name: TAPNet documentation
implementationLessons: Use forward/backward and query-point thinking in the track representation.

name: Roboflow supervision
implementationLessons: Detection/tracking visualisation patterns are useful, but the editor needs temporal corrections and render parity.

name: SAM2 repository
implementationLessons: SAM2’s video memory should be used on explicit prompt/keyframes, not re-encoded for every preview frame.

name: SAM2 model card
implementationLessons: Record code and weight licences separately; expose model download and size before loading.

name: SAM2 ONNX browser conversion
implementationLessons: Use ORT-optimised encoder exports; plain shape-inference failures are a concrete browser failure mode.

name: SAM2 browser implementation study
implementationLessons: The encoder dominates latency; cache embeddings and keep decoder prompts cheap.

name: Transformers.js
implementationLessons: Model abstraction should isolate runtime and dtype from normal users.

name: ONNX Runtime Web
implementationLessons: Probe execution providers and expose a real fallback; do not hard-require WebGPU.

name: ONNX Runtime Web docs
implementationLessons: Lazy loading, graph optimisation, and explicit disposal are needed for stable model sessions.

name: WebNN API
implementationLessons: Keep WebNN as a future capability adapter rather than building core UX around a partial API.

name: MODNet
implementationLessons: A fast licensed model is useful for preview, with sparse refinement and full-resolution final passes.

name: BiRefNet Lite
implementationLessons: Quality tier can preserve fine boundaries while the pipeline avoids per-frame full inference.

name: ISNet ONNX model card
implementationLessons: Record as research-only because the current listing is AGPL-3.0; never silently bundle it.

name: CoTracker repository
implementationLessons: Research ideas only: current project licensing is incompatible with strict MIT/Apache shipping policy.

name: OpenCV inpaint docs
implementationLessons: Repair is a distinct render stage; expose method and failure reason rather than calling blur “inpaint”.

name: Telea inpainting paper
implementationLessons: Boundary-front ordering and isophote continuation inform the CPU repair implementation.

name: PatchMatch paper
implementationLessons: PatchMatch is a real texture fallback for larger holes; use temporal reconstruction when a plate exists.

name: OpenMVS
implementationLessons: A full 3D solve is distinct from a 2D plane track; keep 2.5D honest when footage lacks parallax.

name: COLMAP
implementationLessons: Camera reconstruction needs feature tracks, robust estimation, and explicit scene scale ambiguity.

name: OpenMVG
implementationLessons: Use as research for solve diagnostics; not every shot deserves an expensive 3D solve.

name: Three.js
implementationLessons: Use GLTFLoader, PMREM, explicit disposal, and WebGL fallback; keep scene data serialisable.

name: React Three Fiber
implementationLessons: Use R3F for declarative viewport composition, not for engine state or project serialisation.

name: Drei
implementationLessons: Helpers accelerate the viewport but should not conceal render quality or licence decisions.

name: glTF 2.0 specification
implementationLessons: glTF is the primary interchange model: preserve skins, clips, materials, cameras and extras.

name: glTF sample models
implementationLessons: Use fixtures for loader/skin/animation tests; record each asset licence separately.

name: glTF Validator
implementationLessons: Validate imported assets before they enter the scene; errors should be actionable.

name: Khronos glTF registry
implementationLessons: Track supported extensions explicitly rather than accepting unknown semantics.

name: KTX-Software
implementationLessons: Compressed textures reduce GPU memory and load time; preserve source texture metadata.

name: Draco
implementationLessons: Decoder is a capability; warn when compressed assets need a download or native path.

name: meshoptimizer
implementationLessons: Use for large models and draw-call reduction, not as a prerequisite for a small scene.

name: Three.js RoomEnvironment
implementationLessons: A procedural room gives a deterministic asset-free default environment; it is not a baked lightmap.

name: PMREMGenerator
implementationLessons: Convert HDRI/room sources to PMREM before assigning scene.environment for PBR consistency.

name: RGBELoader
implementationLessons: HDR background and HDR lighting are separate toggles; dispose source texture after PMREM.

name: React Three Lightmap
implementationLessons: Progressive work slices keep a bake interruptible and UI-responsive; cache result and invalidate by scene inputs.

name: three-gpu-baker
implementationLessons: The latest direction is progressive GPU baking with explicit unsupported features; reuse only after checking version/licence.

name: threejs-lightmap-baker
implementationLessons: Bake needs a second UV channel/shared non-overlapping atlas and seam padding.

name: three.js lightbaking
implementationLessons: Separate import/export and worker execution from the scene renderer.

name: xatlas
implementationLessons: Generated lightmap UVs are a pipeline step and need a cache key; never claim a bake without valid UVs.

name: PBRT v4
implementationLessons: Use as a correctness reference for rays, sampling and material energy; do not copy large renderer wholesale.

name: PBRT book
implementationLessons: A CPU reference baker is useful for tests even when production preview uses GPU.

name: Ray Tracing Gems
implementationLessons: Use chapters as optimisation/denoising references with per-technique licence review.

name: Disney BRDF notes
implementationLessons: Material controls should map to principled parameters and remain colour-space aware.

name: Filament materials guide
implementationLessons: Renderer defaults and tone mapping need to be documented so exports match previews.

name: ACES documentation
implementationLessons: Keep scene-linear lighting separate from display transforms and export in explicit transfer functions.

name: OpenColorIO
implementationLessons: Professional colour management belongs in a dedicated layer, not scattered across effects.

name: Blender manual lighting
implementationLessons: Offer light types with physically meaningful intensity/range and warn on shadow cost.

name: Blender manual world environments
implementationLessons: Environment background and illumination can be rotated/intensity-controlled independently.

name: Blender manual light baking
implementationLessons: Baked data is only valid for the exact static scene inputs; edits invalidate it.

name: Blender manual armatures
implementationLessons: Separate rest/bind pose from animation pose and expose constraints as data.

name: Blender glTF animation export
implementationLessons: Imported clips need list/play/loop/trim/retime controls while preserving original animation data.

name: FABRIK paper
implementationLessons: FABRIK is a practical interactive solver and handles unreachable targets cleanly.

name: three-ik
implementationLessons: Useful API reference but old; OmniFrame keeps a small standalone solver for deterministic tests.

name: Fullik
implementationLessons: Constraint types and multi-chain structures inform the native rig data model.

name: IK-threejs
implementationLessons: Offer CCD for quick posing and FABRIK for stable chains; always report solver error.

name: Three.js AnimationMixer
implementationLessons: Clip playback needs a clock independent of React render cadence.

name: Anime.js
implementationLessons: Use restrained timeline motion for shell/landing only; editor playback must be frame-clocked, not CSS-time animated.

name: Anime.js v4 release notes
implementationLessons: Tree-shakable imports and explicit timeline labels are useful for a small landing bundle.

name: Web Animations API
implementationLessons: Prefer CSS/WAAPI for shell motion so render-time animation is not coupled to UI effects.

name: Motion One
implementationLessons: A restrained motion layer is enough; do not animate every control in a dense editor.

name: VS Code workbench
implementationLessons: Borrow workbench information architecture: resizable/contextual panels, not its visual identity.

name: VS Code web
implementationLessons: A dense tool surface can remain accessible when hierarchy and keyboard navigation are explicit.

name: shadcn/ui
implementationLessons: Own the component source and adapt primitives to a dense editor rather than shipping a generic dashboard.

name: Radix Primitives
implementationLessons: Use accessible primitives for focus management and keyboard behaviour.

name: Tailwind CSS
implementationLessons: Tokens and utilities can enforce no-overflow/responsive rules; custom CSS still owns the editor density.

name: Lucide
implementationLessons: One icon family avoids visual noise in a professional tool.

name: React
implementationLessons: React owns interaction/state presentation; media/geometry stays in the engine package.

name: Zustand
implementationLessons: Use selectors to keep a dense workbench responsive; do not store decoded frame buffers in React state.

name: Vite
implementationLessons: Keep the web shell independently buildable while native/Tauri wiring arrives.

name: Vitest
implementationLessons: Engine algorithms are tested in Node without a browser or renderer.

name: Playwright
implementationLessons: Automate route/no-overflow/keyboard smoke tests against the actual browser build.

name: Tauri
implementationLessons: A Tauri 2 shell can expose the Rust core while the same React workbench runs in web mode.

name: Tauri v2 docs
implementationLessons: Native filesystem access must be capability-scoped and never expose arbitrary project code.

name: Tauri filesystem plugin
implementationLessons: Use explicit permission scopes and temp-file/rename atomic saves.

name: Tauri dialog plugin
implementationLessons: Native entry page can share project-open actions with the web adapter.

name: OpenTelemetry logs
implementationLessons: Development logs should be honest structured events, never fabricated activity.

name: W3C Media Capabilities
implementationLessons: Probe codecs before presenting presets and use actual machine results.

name: Web Performance APIs
implementationLessons: Measure startup, first frame, scrub, tracking and export rather than inventing numbers.

name: File API
implementationLessons: Import should preserve a local File/handle reference and avoid unnecessary data URLs.

name: Streams API
implementationLessons: Large exports should be streamed/muxed rather than held as one giant array.

name: WASM SIMD proposal
implementationLessons: SIMD is an optimisation for image loops after profiling, never the baseline correctness path.

name: Rust image crate
implementationLessons: Native adapters can use well-scoped image primitives; the browser reference stays typed-array based.

name: Rust rayon
implementationLessons: Parallelism belongs behind JobManager and must respect cancellation/memory budgets.

name: Rust serde
implementationLessons: Rust and TypeScript project formats need explicit version migrations and stable IDs.

name: Cargo deny
implementationLessons: Automate native dependency licence/advisory checks before release.

name: REUSE tool
implementationLessons: Keep third-party notices machine-readable and complete.
